notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Sorry for the long silence. [/h1]

I was in other projects and didn't think that this one still has their traffic. 
I don't intend to make any more major updates to the game. I wanted to at least make it playable. I will look into the discussions more often in the future. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Drills now work correct
- Crusher now detects corpse correct

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
- Expanded tutorial with enhanced guidance.
- Full controller support.
- Sound effect for cart movement.

[h2]Changed[/h2]
- The blaster is always visible in gamepad mode.
- Entity UI is now displayed when hovering over an entity, instead of requiring a click.
- Improved performance when many ores, corpses, or projectiles are on screen.
- Improved performance during high enemy count scenarios.

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
- Blaster firing after pausing the game.
- Tooltip remaining active after closing build mode.
- Leftover Godot toolchain artifacts when hovering over quickbar numbers.

[h2]Removed[/h2]
- Confusing power consumption information from the score display.
